title: The Free Kick That Turned
coreQuestion: How did Roberto Carlos's 1997 free kick bend the way it did?

facts.claim: Roberto Carlos scored a curling free kick in the opening match between France and Brazil, often considered one of the best in the modern game.
The opening match between France and Brazil was played in Lyon.
Physicists studied the trajectory of his free kick against France.

narration.text: This free kick looked like it was going wide. Then it turned.
Roberto Carlos struck it from far out.
The ball curled around the wall.
Physicists later studied how a spinning ball can curve that way.
It is still called one of the best free kicks of the modern game. Every goal has a story.
